title: Unified initiative ledger for cross-org OKR signals
creator: Ethan Brooks
description:
Background:
Over the past two quarters we’ve seen repeated misalignments between company-level OKR signals and the set of active initiatives across Eng, DevEx, and Product. Teams report duplicate efforts, unclear owners for cross-cutting outcomes, and difficulty translating executive-level objectives into trackable milestones. The existing initiative registry lives in multiple places (spreadsheets, single-team trackers, and an ad-hoc Confluence page) and lacks a consistent signal model for priority, risk, and lead contact.

Problem statement:
We need a single, lightweight ledger that: 1) surfaces authoritative company OKR signals, 2) binds initiatives to objectives with clear ownership, success metrics and delivery runway, and 3) provides a minimal set of attributes for downstream tooling (roadmap exports, capacity planning, and release gating).

Goals (outcomes, not outputs):
- Reduce cross-team duplicate work by 30% (measured via post-mortem tags and duplicate initiative counts).
- Ensure every company-level objective has >=1 aligned initiative with a named owner and measurable key result by the end of Q4.
- Provide exports to Roadmap and Capacity teams so 90% of Heads can view initiative-to-OKR mapping in a single dashboard.

Success metrics:
- % company objectives with at least one aligned initiative: target >=95%
- Number of initiatives tagged as duplicates compared to baseline: -30%
- Stakeholder satisfaction score (survey of Eng/PM/Design leads): >=4/5 after rollout

Scope (in-scope):
- Define the ledger schema (minimal attributes: objective_key, initiative_key, owner, stage, runway, risks, success_metrics, related_projects).
- Implement the canonical ledger as a Confluence-backed registry with a small API surface (read-only JSON export) and a CSV import/export.
- Add tooling templates and Slack cadence for monthly ledger reviews during PM/OD sync.

Out-of-scope (for this ticket):
- Full platform integration with Console or automated gating. We'll design hooks but defer implementation to a separate ENG ticket.

Stakeholders:
- Exec sponsor: Maya Singh (CEO office)
- Product leads: Rina Gomez (Assignee), Tomas Becker
- Eng leads: Priya Nair (Runtime), Jorge Martinez (Infrastructure)
- Design: Lina Ho (DX)
- GTM: Zoe Patel

Milestones and timeline:
- Week 1 (2025-09-10 to 2025-09-16): Schema proposal and stakeholder review (PRD sketch)
- Week 2 (2025-09-17 to 2025-09-23): Confluence ledger prototype and CSV import/export spec
- Week 3 (2025-09-24 to 2025-09-30): Runway tagging and export API prototype; pilot with two initiatives
- Week 4-6 (2025-10-01 to 2025-10-20): Feedback cycle, training materials, and rollout to all leads
- Week 7 (2025-10-21 to 2025-11-03): Dashboard wiring and stakeholder survey

Risks and trade-offs:
- Trade-off: minimal schema keeps adoption friction low but may omit nuanced attributes teams want later (we’ll version the schema).
- Risk: decentralized ownership — if team leads don’t update the ledger monthly, the registry will go stale. Mitigation: tie ledger review to PM/OD sync and add lightweight reminders.

Artifacts and links:
- PRD (working): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OKR/Unified+Initiative+Ledger
- Ledger prototype (Confluence page): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OKR/Ledger+Prototype
- CSV import spec (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ledger-spec
- Pilot initiative template (docs): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PilotTemplate
- GitHub draft for read-only export: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/1482

Acceptance criteria (must pass to close ticket):
- Schema doc reviewed and approved by Eng, Product, and Design (comment thread on Confluence resolved).
- Prototype ledger page populated with at least 8 active initiatives (cross-org sample).
- Read-only JSON export available via the GH PR merge and validated by Roadmap team.
- Training checklist and one live walkthrough scheduled with Heads and recorded.

Next steps (immediate):
- 2025-09-12: Finalize schema and add to Confluence (owner: Rina)
updates: 2025-09-12 — Schema v0.1 posted to Confluence; Priya and Lina left initial comments on success_metrics field. Action: Rina to reconcile metric naming by 09/15.
2025-09-15 — PM/Eng sync: agreed to keep 'runway' as 4 buckets (Discovery, Build, Launch, Monitor). Tomas requested an optional 'capacity_owner' field for Dedicated initiatives; accepted as opt-in.
2025-09-24 — Pilot run: added two runtime initiatives and exported CSV; Roadmap team confirmed schema maps to their view with minor column renames. Filed ENG-9023 for API export hardening.
2025-09-30 — Design review: Lina submitted UI microcopy suggestions for the Confluence template (clarify 'owner' vs 'responsible team'). Incorporating feedback; plan demo 2025-10-05.
2025-10-02 — Exec review: Maya flagged a need to include a short rationale field to capture why initiative exists relative to objective. Added to schema as 'rationale_short'.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Schema approved by PM/Eng/Design; 2) Ledger populated with >=8 initiatives; 3) JSON export validated; 4) Training scheduled and recorded; 5) Survey template ready for post-rollout.
